abstract: Three IgM mouse monoclonal antibodies, NL-9, Thy-22, and HL-5, which were produced primarily against human hematopoietic cells, were tested for their reactivity with various mouse cell lines and were found to react predominantly with mouse embryonal carcinoma cells. Thy-22 reacted with 2-cell-stage mouse embryos, whereas the other two antibodies were not reactive at this stage. All three antibodies, however, reacted with 8-cell-stage embryos. At the blastocyst stage, Thy-22 reacted with the entire surface of the trophectoderm cells, whereas the reactivity of NL-9 and HL-5 was weaker and was polarized on the mural trophectoderm. Immunohistological examination of 6th-day mouse embryos using anti-complement immunofluorescence demonstrated that the embryonic ectoderm was positive for all three antibodies: the reaction of NL-9 and Thy-22 was uniformly distributed over these cells, whereas HL-5 predominantly stained the luminal aspects of the cells lining the proamniotic cavity. Visceral-endoderm cells and trophoblastic cells were positive with all three monoclonal antibodies, whereas the parietal endoderm, extraembryonic ectoderm, and ectoplacental cone were negative. In 19th-day fetuses and adult tissues, certain epithelial cells were stained by these three antibodies. The biochemical nature of the antigens detected was also investigated. Farr's assay showed that both NL-9 and Thy-22 precipitated approximately 10% of the high-molecular-mass glycopeptides isolated from F9 cells, while HL-5 reacted with about 5% of these glycopeptides. The reactivity of the three antibodies against the glycopeptides was completely inhibited by the presence of X-hapten-conjugated silica.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: ヒト造血細胞に対して主に作製された3種のIgMマウスモノクローナル抗体、NL-9、Thy-22、HL-5を、各種マウス細胞株との反応性について検討したところ、主にマウス胎児性癌細胞と反応することがわかった。Thy-22は2細胞期のマウス胚と反応したが、他の2抗体は同段階で反応しなかった。しかし3種とも8細胞期胚と反応した。胚盤胞期では、Thy-22は栄養外胚葉細胞の全表面と反応したが、NL-9とHL-5の反応は弱く、壁側栄養外胚葉に偏在していた。6日目のマウス胚の免疫組織学的検討では、補体を用いた蛍光抗体法により、胚性外胚葉は3抗体すべてに陽性であった。NL-9とThy-22の反応は一様に分布していたが、HL-5は羊膜腔を裏打ちする細胞の管腔側を主に染色した。臓側内胚葉と栄養芽細胞はすべての抗体に陽性であったが、壁側内胚葉、胚外外胚葉、外胚葉性円錐は陰性であった。19日目の胎児および成体組織では、特定の上皮細胞が3抗体により染色された。抗原の生化学的性質も検討した。Farr法の結果、NL-9とThy-22はF9細胞由来の高分子糖ペプチドの約10%を沈降させ、HL-5は約5%を沈降させた。3抗体の糖ペプチドに対する反応性は、X-ハプテン結合シリカの存在により完全に阻害された。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
